Method of Attack: Spam email campaigns with malicious document attachments containing embedded macros that install the Trojan
Downloading TrickBot malware to steal data after Emotet infection
Using infected computers to send further spam
Attack Vector: Malicious email attachments (Word documents) with embedded macros
Indicators of Compromise: Emails with subjects like 'Christmas Party next week', 'Christmas party', 'holiday schedule 2019-2020', 'Our holiday schedules', 'holiday', 'holiday schedule'
Malicious Word documents named 'Christmas party.doc' and 'Party menu.doc'
User prompted to click 'Enable Editing' or 'Enable Content' to activate macros
